svg.title: Vendora architecture
svg.desc: Invoices, purchase orders, contracts and correspondence flow into an extraction agent, then an orchestrator with an evidence store, then matching and investigation agents, a supervisor, and a human approval step. Every step is written to an audit trail.
svg.text: Claude structured outputs on native PDFs. Every field keeps its page and clause reference.
no approval or payment without a person
every step, decision and piece of evidence is logged
every agent writes to the log
